---
title: "What is the all-up mass of the stall-bounded planform optimum under the library mass model?"
---

{{< include _model.qmd >}}

```{python}
ENTRY_CEILING = 120.0   # s for this render, granted by the user
SOLVE_BUDGET = 15.0     # s for any one solve
PROBE_POOL = 200.0        # s granted for the probe
PROBE_SPENT = 22.5      # s the probe actually used

stall_angle = 6.7

sink_rate, opt_plane = optimize_geometry_library(get_airplane, alpha_max=stall_angle)

total_mass_g = opt_plane.m_total * 1000
ballast_mass_g = opt_plane.mass_ballast * 1000
alpha_trim = opt_plane.alpha_trim

dens_surf = 0.1744
dens_vol = dens_surf / 0.005

wing_mass_g = sum(w.area() for w in opt_plane.wings) * dens_surf * 1e3
fuse_mass_g = opt_plane.fuselages[0].volume() * dens_vol * 1e3
engine_mass_g = sum(f.volume() for f in opt_plane.fuselages if "Engine" in f.name) * dens_vol * 1e3
gun_mass_g = sum(f.volume() for f in opt_plane.fuselages if "Gun" in f.name) * dens_vol * 1e3
cosmetics_mass_g = engine_mass_g + gun_mass_g

wing_share = wing_mass_g / total_mass_g * 100
fuse_share = fuse_mass_g / total_mass_g * 100
engine_share = engine_mass_g / total_mass_g * 100
gun_share = gun_mass_g / total_mass_g * 100
ballast_share = ballast_mass_g / total_mass_g * 100

assert total_mass_g > 50.0
assert ballast_mass_g < 1e-4
assert abs(wing_mass_g + fuse_mass_g + engine_mass_g + gun_mass_g - total_mass_g) < 0.05
```

::: {.hero}
[`{python} f"{total_mass_g:.2f} g"`]{.hero-value}
[all-up mass of stall-bounded planform optimum under library mass model]{.hero-label}
:::

**Answer.** Under the [library mass model](2026-09-30-01-does-replacing-hand-rolled-mass-geometry-with-wing-area-and-fuselage-v.qmd), the [stall-bounded planform optimum](2026-09-29-03-what-is-the-minimum-trimmed-sink-rate-when-bounded-below-the-section-s.qmd) reaches an all-up mass of [`{python} f"{total_mass_g:.2f} g"`]{.key}. Because the aircraft trims at [`{python} f"{alpha_trim:.1f}°"`]{.key} without requiring nose ballast ([`{python} f"{ballast_mass_g:.1f} g"`]{.key}), the all-up mass consists entirely of the airframe components. The enlarged wings account for [`{python} f"{wing_mass_g:.2f} g"`]{.key} and the fuselage accounts for [`{python} f"{fuse_mass_g:.2f} g"`]{.key}. Cosmetic engine nacelles and cannons contribute the remaining [`{python} f"{cosmetics_mass_g:.2f} g"`]{.key} (@tbl-mass-breakdown).

```{python}
#| label: tbl-mass-breakdown
#| tbl-cap: "Component mass breakdown of the stall-bounded planform optimum under the library mass model."
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

header = ["Component", "Mass", "Share"]
rows = [
    ("Wings", f"{wing_mass_g:.2f} g", f"{wing_share:.1f}%"),
    ("Fuselage", f"{fuse_mass_g:.2f} g", f"{fuse_share:.1f}%"),
    ("Engines", f"{engine_mass_g:.2f} g", f"{engine_share:.1f}%"),
    ("Cannons", f"{gun_mass_g:.2f} g", f"{gun_share:.1f}%"),
    ("Ballast", f"{ballast_mass_g:.2f} g", f"{ballast_share:.1f}%"),
    ("Total all-up", f"{total_mass_g:.2f} g", "100.0%"),
]
md_table(header, rows)
```
